artworks.title: Seated Beggar
artworks.description: The image depicts an older man with a hunched back, sitting or crouching with one leg extended forward. His face is turned slightly towards the viewer, showing his prominent nose and downcast eyes. The man has thin, unkempt hair and is dressed in loose-fitting clothing with rolled-up sleeves and pants that gather at the knees. He is holding a long walking stick and has a hat in his lap. The background is minimally detailed, with a simple textured surface. Handwritten text is visible at the upper part of the image.

artworks.title: Beggar Woman Fleaing a Boy
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting against a tree, their face obscured. They have long hair, wearing a hat and a flowing garment. The ground has a textured appearance, and there is a basket with a stick nearby. The background features part of a tree with detailed bark and some foliage, with a signature "J van Vliet in" in the upper right corner.

artworks.title: The Peddler
artworks.description: The image shows a person reclined against a large tree trunk. The person faces forward, extending an arm outward. They have a broad nose, thick mustache, and wear a hat with a furry brim. The person is wearing a coat, draped clothing, and cuffed pants. They hold a compartmentalized box with various objects. The background is shaded with cross-hatching, featuring the tree trunk and foliage. In the top right corner, the text "J van Vliet" is signed.

artworks.title: The Rat Catcher
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with their body slightly bent forward. The person's head is turned slightly towards the right, and their arms are extended forward. They have a beard and are wearing a large fluffy hat that ties under their chin. Their clothing is loose with puffy long sleeves and tied around the waist with a belt. They have a large, circular basket slung on their back, which is supported by a staff that rests on the ground. In front of them, there is a flat surface with several mice on it, and a few more mice hang from strings below. The background has a sparse, simple depiction of grass or small foliage.

artworks.title: The Hurdy-Gurdy Player
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a slightly hunched position with their head tilted forward and their gaze directed downwards. The person has a prominent facial structure with barely visible features due to the angle and shadow. They are wearing a hat adorned with tall feathers and possibly fur-lined, as well as a loose-fitting, historical outfit. In their left arm, they hold a rectangular object and a round object is visible hanging on their right side. The background features minimalistic renderings of foliage and the ground, with an aged, textured look.

artworks.title: Beggar Woman Playing the Violin
artworks.description: The image depicts a person playing a fiddle. The individual is in mid-stride, playing the instrument with one hand and holding a bow in the other. They have long, tousled hair, a large hat covering much of their head, and wear a loose-fitting dress that reaches their feet. The background is minimal, with a plain texture suggesting grass or soil at their feet.

artworks.title: On the "Pont de l'Europe"
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals facing each other. The person on the right stands in a three-quarter view, wearing a checked dress in red and blue, holding a dark object in their right hand, and draped in a textured shawl. The individual on the left, a child, is seen in profile with light-colored hair tied back and wearing a dark top with a light-colored skirt. Both individuals wear boots. The background shows a textured, rustic wall in muted tones.

artworks.title: The First of September, Morning
artworks.description: This shows a painting of a stable scene with animals. The interior of the stable has wooden beams and structures, horses standing near hay racks, dogs gathering at the center, a broom on the ground, shelves with containers, and a window. Light and shadow play create a cozy atmosphere in the stable. This artwork is in the style of Sir Edwin Landseer.

artworks.title: The First of September, Evening
artworks.description: The image depicts a rustic scene outside a thatched-roof building. Several individuals are gathered around a small rural inn, possibly engaging in a social gathering. The foreground captures people with a horse, interacting. A man sits on a bench in front of the building, engaging with a dog, while another stands holding a piece of game. A child observes the scene. Dogs are resting in the foreground. The building has a slanted thatched roof and a weathered exterior, giving it an antiquated charm. The background shows a dimming sky, indicating early evening. The style resembles 18th-century rural genre scenes, similar to Thomas Gainsborough's work.

artworks.title: Robert Burns
artworks.artist: William Walker and Samuel Cousins after Alexander Nasmyth
artworks.description: The image shows a man portrayed from the waist up in a classic seated position. He is slightly turned to the right with his head facing ahead. His facial features are finely detailed with a soft, youthful expression, characterized by a slightly elongated face, pronounced cheekbones, and a smooth complexion. He has short, well-groomed hair with a slight wave and sideburns that frame his face. He is dressed in period attire, wearing a dark coat over a high-necked, pleated white shirt. The background features a subtle, cloudy sky with suggestions of foliage.

artworks.title: Lucinda, Miss Moore
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a woman seated with her body slightly angled to the side. Her head is tilted to her right shoulder and she is looking directly at the viewer. She has delicate facial features including a softly rounded face and subtle eyebrows. Her hair is partially covered by an elaborate hat with ruffles or floral decorations. She is wearing a detailed flowing garment, possibly made of silk-like fabric, which drapes around her shoulders and arms. In her left hand, she holds a piece of paper or lace. The background is dark with faintly visible furniture or structures behind her.

artworks.title: Samuel Johnson
artworks.artist: James Watson after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a half-length portrait. He is in profile, looking to his left, with his right arm raised and hand near his chin, and his left hand below holding his garment. He has a prominent nose, a strong jawline, and a contemplative expression. His hair is short, wavy, and shaded light. He wears a draped garment over a collared shirt with a slightly open neckline. In the background, there are large books on a shelf and a rolled scroll. The background is dark, emphasizing the figure.

artworks.title: Catherine, Lady Bampfylde
artworks.artist: Thomas Watson after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in three-quarter view, leaning against a low stone wall. Her face is turned towards the viewer, with her gaze directed sideways. She has defined facial features, including arched eyebrows, a straight nose, and slightly parted lips. Her hair is styled in an elaborate updo with curls and a headdress. She wears a gown with puffed sleeves, a textured shawl, and a floral decoration on her bodice. She wears a pearl necklace and holds a bouquet of flowers. The background features trees and a landscape. A flowering plant is beside her on the right.

artworks.title: Portrait of Whistler
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body, capturing him from the chest up. The man is slightly turned to the side with his head facing the viewer. He has distinct facial features, including a mustache and curly hair. The man is wearing a structured coat with a high collar, buttoned at the front, and beneath it, a lighter-colored shirt is visible. The background is plain with a subtle texture. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Saint Benedict
artworks.medium: brush (and pen?) with gray ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man wearing a long robe. He has somber facial features, short hair, and is holding a staff and an object. A halo is over his head. Near him are a wall, buildings, and trees. At his feet are a book and a mitre. Latin text is in the border of the image. The background is plain and neutral.

artworks.title: Knight and the Servant
artworks.description: In the image, there are two figures depicted. On the left is a knight in full armor riding a horse adorned with detailed attire. The knight's face is covered by a helmet with plumes. On the right is a person standing on foot, leaning forward with a spear. This individual has short hair and is wearing a padded garment with fitted pants. The background shows a lush forest with dense foliage.

artworks.title: Baptism in Jordan
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a baptism scene. The image shows a figure kneeling in water while another figure pours water over their head. There are angelic beings with large wings surrounding the scene, and a divine presence appears in the clouds above. The background includes elements like trees and flowing water. The drawing is detailed with delicate line work, capturing human expressions and textures of nature. The composition is balanced with a heavenly radiance from the divine figure in the clouds, highlighted by the symmetry and peaceful arrangement of the celestial beings.

artworks.title: Pyrgoteles
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure standing beside a platform in a natural setting with cloudy skies. The figure is nude with muscular detailing and holds a staff with a sign that reads "PVRGOTELES." In front of the figure is an architecturally styled platform or altar, and the background features tall plants, possibly reeds. The sky is depicted with swirling clouds in contrasting shades. The overall composition conveys a classical or mythological theme, using strong lines and hatching to show textures and depths in the scene.

artworks.title: Last Supper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of people gathered around a table for a meal. The scene shows individuals sitting around an oval table, which is decorated with simple food items and cups. The color palette is modest, with yellows, blues, and earthy tones. Each figure wears a robe and many are depicted with a circular halo above their heads. The figures have elongated features and closed eyes. The background features a curved architectural element, possibly an arch or a window, framing the gathering. The style resembles a medieval or early Renaissance woodcut illustration, reminiscent of religious art from that period.

artworks.title: Mary Magdalen Washing Feet of Christ
artworks.description: This is a print of a group of people seated at a dining table, with others standing nearby and watching them. In the front, a woman with long hair partially covered by a shawl is kneeling, facing the left, her face near the foot of a seated man. There is a bucket on the ground next to her. The table behind her is covered with various plates, cups, and food. More men are seated around the table, with a group of men standing on the right, observing the scene. The people all wear robes and different head coverings, and many of them, including the woman, have halos behind their head. The background features a window on the left with more people visible through it, and on the right an opening shows a person sitting among leafy vines.

artworks.title: Pietà
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a scene with a central figure and a cross in the background. The drawing features a central, emaciated figure draped across the lap of a seated figure. Both figures are rendered in strong lines characteristic of woodcuts, with emphasis on folds of fabric and anatomical details. The cross in the background has a draped cloth, and a circular form near the central figure's head. Surrounding elements include a thorny crown and barren tree branches.

artworks.title: The Man of Sorrows Standing
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image): 29.9 x 22.7 cm (11 3/4 x 8 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with his arms outstretched, looking downward. He has a beard, long hair, and wears a loincloth. A crown of thorns adorns his head, with rays emanating from it. He holds a staff or spear in his left hand. In the background, a rooster stands by a draped cloth on a wooden frame, with coins and dice scattered nearby. Hills or mountains and clouds with rain or beam lines are visible. The text "ECCE HOMO" is inscribed to the left.

artworks.title: Allegory - Religious Frivolity
artworks.description: The image is a black and white illustration featuring a group of robed figures in what seems to be a religious or medieval setting. The figures are shown from the waist up, with many facing towards the right side where an angelic figure is seated on a cloud, blowing a trumpet. The people have different hairstyles and various expressions. They are dressed in robes with intricate details, some with patterned collars or cuffs. One figure holds a string of beads. In the background, there is a cloudy sky, setting a divine tone. The line work in the image adds texture and emphasizes the historical and stylistic themes.

artworks.title: Page from Troianischen Kreig - Ausberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene with text. The image features a detailed woodcut illustration depicting a scene from a classical story. The image shows a figure sitting on a chair or throne on the left side. They are adorned in regal attire. In the center, a figure approaches with a sword. To the right, creatures or armored figures appear to be emerging from a cluster, holding shields and helmets. The scene is surrounded by decorative elements, and the drawing is framed above and below by text in a stylized script, recounting a narrative related to Ulysses. The details and layout suggest a story from ancient mythology.
